tasks.analysis: Climate varies significantly across different regions of the world because it is affected by many factors. These include the amount of sunlight and distance from the ocean. Some places are very warm with very little rain, like deserts. Others may have a cold climate with lots of snow, like the Arctic. Yet others experience mild climates and four distinct seasons.
